CheckTitle: Security Groups with FTP ports (20,21) open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to FTP ports.
Risk: FTP (ports 20/21) transmits credentials and data in clear text, allowing eavesdropping, unauthorized file uploads/downloads, and server compromise.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
